message: Turn 7 reviewed. Cleanup is accepted as safe based on recovery/CLEANUP.md. Continue the independent audit of .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py and .agent-handoff/install-autostart.ps1, including latest agent-handoff changes. New confirmed live-Windows observations from the user's install on 2026-09-24: (1) the old Dispatcher 2.2 log says NEW TURN 8 -> ARENA at 13:37:00, 'ARENA: command sent (turn_id=8)' at 13:37:06, then consumed turn 8, yet the user reports they did not observe the wake and manually sent it; audit exact-tab selection and whether send success is falsely assumed after editor.press('Enter'). (2) Re-running install-autostart after Dispatcher 2.2.1 was committed printed only old log lines through 13:43:36 and no fresh 'AI Dispatcher 2.2.1 started' line, but still reported Installed. The installer currently matches the pre-existing substring 'AI Dispatcher 2.2' in the old log, so startup verification can false-positive; fix this. (3) PowerShell output shows mojibake for Cyrillic because the UTF-8 Python log is read by Get-Content without explicit UTF-8 decoding; fix installer log display. (4) urllib raw-GitHub polling produced confirmed transient RemoteDisconnected / TLS handshake timeout / UNEXPECTED_EOF errors; loop survived, but audit whether bounded retry/backoff should be added. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Keep workspace lean. Report only confirmed issues with exact file/line references; commit needed fixes on agent-handoff and return resulting SHA.
